observations: Photo 0 and photo 1: a V8 petrol engine with a long rear-wheel-drive automatic gearbox bolted behind it, lying on a concrete floor in a parts yard among other engines.
The gearbox has a long tail housing and an output shaft at the rear, typical of a truck or van automatic; casing is dusty and covered in dried leaves and dirt.
Wiring harness, hoses, a blue cooler or breather line and coil packs still attached to the engine.
Photo 2: top view from the engine end along the gearbox; casing intact, no visible cracks, but heavy dirt; a person's legs and slippers at the side.
A small badge on the left valve cover in photo 0 is too small to read; no gearbox ID tag, brand logo or part number is readable in any photo.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'GEARUP INC.' on all photos; this is the seller's mark.
No dipstick, fluid, torque converter close-up or running test is shown.

identity.kind: used rear-wheel-drive automatic gearbox for an American V8 van or truck
read_from: photo 0 gearbox shape and V8 engine

claims.claim: Gearbox for Ford Econoline E150 E250 E350 V8
claims.evidence: Photos 0 to 2 show a V8 with a long rear-wheel-drive automatic, consistent with a Ford V8 van, but no Ford badge, gearbox tag or part number is readable.
The layout looks like an American V8 rear-wheel-drive unit, but nothing in the photos confirms the origin or spec.
Photos show a used unit in a local yard; nothing can show remotely whether it was imported and never used locally.

risks.risk: Gearbox may slip, fail to shift or have internal damage; nothing shows it working.
risks.proof: Clip of the gearbox fitted and running, engaging reverse and drive and shifting through the gears under load.
risks.if_unproven: as not working, a core for rebuild

risks.risk: Exact gearbox type and fit (model year, 2WD or 4WD, which V8) unknown; it may not fit the buyer's van.
risks.proof: Close photo of the ID tag or stamped part number on the side of the gearbox case.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic American V8 automatic gearbox, fit not guaranteed

risks.risk: Burnt or contaminated fluid showing worn clutches.
risks.proof: Photo of the fluid on the dipstick or drained from the pan on white paper.

risks.risk: Unclear what is included: the engine in the photos, the torque converter, the computer.
risks.proof: Written list of what is in the sale and a photo of the bell housing showing the torque converter.
risks.if_unproven: as gearbox only without torque converter

proof_requests: Close photo of the gearbox ID tag or part number on the case.
Clip of the gearbox running and shifting through all gears, with reverse.
Photo of the gearbox fluid on white paper.
Confirmation of what is included, with a photo of the torque converter in the bell housing.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a used rear-wheel-drive automatic gearbox from an American V8, consistent with the seller's van claim, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working core of that type, with the ID tag and a shifting clip as the proof that would raise it.
